gloss_en: drawing near / coming close to God (Hitkarvut la-Shem) — the devotional act of a person being brought close to the blessed Creator and His true service (root ק-ר-ב in the reflexive hitpael, לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ); not physical proximity, sacrificial offering (קָרְבָּן), or battle (קְרָב)
